notes: The tuition fee for the Biochemical Engineering BSc is 7,000 USD/year. The tuition fee page lists the programme but does not state a separate amount. The application deadline is recurring (15 June) without a year. The programme starts in September each year; no exact date is given. The application channel is direct application through the university's online platform. The English proficiency requirement is B2, but a certificate is not strictly required as skills are assessed during the interview. The programme page states entrance exams in Mathematics and either Chemistry or Biology; the requirements rule uses subjects mathematics, physics-chemistry, and life-earth-sciences as a proxy, but the exact subjects are Mathematics and Chemistry or Biology.

evidence.quote: Applicants must have an English proficiency of at least B2 level as the program is fully taught in English.
a TOEFL test with a minimum score of 513 (Paper-Based). an IELTS test with a minimum score of 5.5.
Please note, that you are not strictly required to have a language exam certificate, your language skills will be assessed during the entrance interview.
